ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 2.5:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white region on the distal portions of both lobes. Contiguous low-intensity black region extending from the peduncle into the central 30% of each lobe. Irregular black mottling clusters in the mid-section of the left lobe. Discrete dark linear streaks located on the upper quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped median notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth of roughly 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-serrations with pixel-amplitudes of 2-5 pixels across the entire trailing edge. Three major macro-peaks (>10 pixel amplitude) visible on the medial trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curves fitted to the distal edges of both lobes, transitioning to a slight concavity as they approach the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, dark, circular pixel clusters (approx. 4-6 pixels in diameter) localized on the proximal-inner section of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the right lobe; several intersecting unaligned linear marks on the central-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Highly irregular, jagged trailing edge on the left lobe suggests significant historical tissue loss or trauma; right lobe tip exhibits a localized downward-pointing jagged protrusion.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, isolated dark spot located at the extreme distal tip of the right fluke.
